topics.topic: Actor and cause attribution for manual versus admission trial executions
questions: What actor or cause must a TrialExecution record carry so manual trials can be attributed to the requesting agent and admission trials to the kernel?
What fact distinguishes an agent-requested trial execution from a kernel-run admission execution, and which agent requested an explicit trial?

quotes:
The evidence of running one implementation on one trial case (K-05). Read by
admission and by the agent repairing the slot.
judgement.why: The change only clarified when trial outputs exist and did not alter the unchanged TrialExecution passage concerning execution attribution.

topics.topic: Authority used to resume or retry an effect after not_sent
questions: Under what authority is a `draft-write` retried after `not_sent`, since its original authority is a flow activation rather than an approval?
What authority does the resumed send use when a `not_sent` attempt originally used a standing grant or a flow activation rather than an approval?

quotes:
A `not_sent` attempt leaves its approval
unused (M24), so a resume sends a new attempt under it. Sending again after `not_applied` is a new attempt
under a fresh approval, never under a standing approval (K-08).
judgement.why: The change added EffectAttempt input references but did not alter the unchanged rule about authority after `not_sent`.

topics.topic: Trial cases executed by one explicit try-an-implementation action
questions: Which TrialExecutions does one try action create: one for every active case, one caller-selected case, or a caller-selected subset?
Which TrialCases does one explicit try-an-implementation action execute?

quotes:
The evidence of running one implementation on one trial case (K-05). Read by
admission and by the agent repairing the slot.
judgement.why: The change clarified TrialExecution outputs but did not touch which trial cases an explicit try action executes.

topics.topic: Actor or actors preserved by ContractVersion issued_by
questions: Does `issued_by` name the requesting agent, the kernel that mints the version, or must the record preserve both actors?

topics.topic: Behavior of an activated implementation when corpus growth invalidates its admission
questions: When a trial case is added, what happens if the currently activated implementation has no admitted verdict over the enlarged corpus, and may a run still start with it?

topics.topic: Behavior of repeated acceptance when the service has no selected instance
questions: When the owner repeats accept on an already accepted binding after the installation no longer selects an instance for its service, is the accepted binding returned or is the action refused?

topics.topic: Identity and idempotency of repeated admission verdicts and trial executions
questions: If admission is performed again for the same implementation and corpus, is the existing AdmissionVerdict returned, or is a new verdict with new TrialExecutions created; and which of those observations are identity facts?
Is NodeExecution a content-substitutable value, or an observation entity whose identity is `(run_id, node_id, map_index, attempt_number)`?

topics.topic: Installation identity and configuration versioning when tokens change
questions: When tokens change, is this the same installation with mutable configuration, a new Installation value, or a stable installation associated with successive configuration snapshots?

topics.topic: Whether K-11 MCP operations exhaustively cover the Primary actions
questions: Are the K-11 names exhaustive MCP operations, broad operation families containing every Primary action, or an incomplete list?

topics.topic: Whether ProofResult can change as referenced binding acceptance changes
questions: Is a ProofResult determined solely by `flow_version_id`, or can the same immutable flow version have different proof results as referenced bindings change from proposed to accepted?

topics.topic: Whether TrialExecution file outputs store or derive disclosure class
questions: Does each file output in TrialExecution also carry its disclosure class, or is that class deliberately omitted and derived from the trial inputs when read?

topics.topic: Whether an accepted binding becomes invocable again after manifest digest reversion
questions: If the manifest operation changes and later returns exactly to the binding’s pinned digest, does the existing accepted binding become invocable again, or does the earlier mismatch permanently require a newly accepted binding?
